name: Blueberry Kush - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 1g
description: Rove 1G Ice Pack Preroll, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin then they're expertly rolled. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 40% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Premium Organic Flower. Get ready for an energizing, euphoric high that will take you to a paradise of fruity flavors and tropical vibes. Don't worry about feeling too sedated or lethargic—you'll get the right amount of heady relaxation you need. This powerful indica strain provides an almost immediate calming sensation and deep relaxation with sweet berry tones, helping you take on the day or catch some much-needed shut-eye.
